agents.page.terminal: The same from a terminal: `daoris agent list` says each account, `daoris agent login {{agent}} --new` signs in to another, and `daoris agent profile …` sets how they are used.
agents.page.terminalKey: The same from a terminal: `daoris agent list` says each account, `daoris agent key {{agent}}` adds an account from an API key read from standard input, `daoris agent key {{agent}} --account <account>` sets or replaces one's key, and `daoris agent profile …` sets how they are used.
agents.page.terminalAbsent: The same from a terminal: `daoris agent install {{agent}}`.
